actual_game_ui: Unavailable for new concepts without supported runtime slots; no adoption review claimed.

cells.subject: briar-hook
cells.notes: Strong recurved hook and diagonal shaft; quiet ground shadow. Counterweight becomes a small secondary droplet at compact size. Useful concept, no runtime acceptance.

cells.subject: saltglass-glaive
cells.notes: Broad crescent and fitted socket read clearly. Pale layered planes suggest smoky glass but retain an opaque illustrated quality; no physical glass-rendering claim.

cells.subject: bellows-maul
cells.notes: Heavy head, attached split handle and broad copper bellows cheek read at compact size; internal slats recede.

cells.subject: ossuary-lantern-flail
cells.notes: Hollow cage, short handle and chain remain identifiable. Small chain junctions are compressed at 80px; hold attachment detail for any future runtime adaptation.

cells.subject: furnace-kite
cells.notes: Asymmetric notch and folded copper side plane read immediately; lower rim and grounded thickness survive compact view.

cells.subject: reed-quiver
cells.notes: Reed body, strap and three bolt heads stay distinct. Fine lashings recede at compact size; silhouette remains useful.

pilot_decision: Proceed with remaining nonliving families; six clearly separable strong silhouettes and connected broad material planes. No reroll justified.
aesthetic_acceptance: User acceptance pending; technical success is separate.
